summary: Tested image loading fixes for Expo Go Android. Verified: main menu background (mainpage.webp), game-loading screen (bg-tavern.jpg), all 4 intro scenes (intro1-4.jpg), portrait images (rupert.png, rupertlaugh.png, rupertsad.png, avatar1_tired.png), and full New Game → Slot → Name → Begin Adventure → Loading → Intro flow. All images load and display correctly on web preview.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' - Non-breaking, carry-over from previous iteration.

action_items: LOW: Consider migrating TouchableWithoutFeedback to Pressable in intro.tsx (non-breaking deprecation warning)
critical_code_review_comments: AssetManager.ts: ExpoImage.prefetch() correctly removed - only asset.downloadAsync() remains. expo-image handles require() caching automatically.
All Image imports switched from react-native to expo-image with contentFit prop - correct.
JPEG background images confirmed: bg-tavern.jpg (331KB), intro1-4.jpg (~160-220KB each), kitchen1.jpg (184KB), garden1.jpg (400KB) - significantly smaller than PNG originals.
Portrait images (.png ~512px) render correctly in circular clips in dialog panel.
Web decode helper (_decodeWeb) still present in AssetManager for web Platform.OS - correct behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image fix fully confirmed. All JPEG background images and PNG portraits load correctly. New game flow: Main Menu → New Game → Slot 1 → Name → Begin Adventure → Loading (bg-tavern.jpg at 100%) → Intro scenes 1-5 (intro1-4.jpg) → Dialog panel with portrait (rupertlaugh.png). No blank/missing images found anywhere in the flow.
